main_text.head: THESIS I.
main_text.p: Um veritas omnis simplex est, & cujusque rei non nisi unica dari potest: tum error multiplex & sæpe circa eandem rem varius esse solet. Id quod tunc maxime contingere videas, quando plures, qui in eandem rem indagandam incumbunt; rebus nondum satis exacte per-

page.notes: The large initial "C" of "Cum" is a woodcut initial and is read as C joined to Um. The paragraph is set in the printed text as "Um veritas" with the initial letter; the first word is therefore given as "Um" with the initial C. Scan is slightly faint at the right edge of the text block. The first line of the thesis is set in a larger initial; the line "per-" ends the printed page with a hyphen.
